args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation to local MinIO setup
args.body:
File: docs/setup.md

Add instructions to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable to http://localhost:9000 and create the bucket for local MinIO usage, as the current setup steps omit these essential details, causing confusion.

label: docs
file: docs/setup.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The setup instructions for running locally with MinIO miss mentioning the need to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable and to create the bucket. These details are vital for correct configuration and are best added to docs/setup.md to improve clarity.
